summary: Auth refactor regression (Emergent-managed Google auth -> real Google Identity Services). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_auth_google_regression.py with 6 pytest cases — all 6 PASSED. Verified: email/password login (admin@autoacquire.ai / Admin123!) still returns JWT+user; token authorizes GET /api/auth/me and GET /api/leads (200); wrong password -> 401; NEW POST /api/auth/google returns 401 for an invalid credential and 422 for missing 'credential' field; OLD POST /api/auth/google/session correctly returns 404 (endpoint removed). Frontend (Playwright on public preview URL): /login renders with zero console errors, Google GIS iframe is injected inside [data-testid='google-login-btn'] (1 iframe detected), email/password sign-in as admin lands on /app/dashboard, and all core authenticated pages — Dashboard, Leads, Inventory, Appointments, Analytics, Settings — navigate cleanly with no inline errors and no console errors. All requested regression cases pass.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py google_login: uses generic `except Exception` for id_token verification. Consider catching google.auth.exceptions.GoogleAuthError specifically and logging the failure reason (aud mismatch vs. expired vs. malformed) — helpful when debugging real-user Google sign-in failures.
auth.py: no rate limiting on /api/auth/google (or /login). Not blocking, but any brute-attempt against the endpoint is unmetered.

Login.jsx: setInterval polling for window.google is left running if the component unmounts before GIS loads on very slow networks — cleanup exists, but a hard cap on attempts would guard against pathological cases.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + Google button render + all 6 core pages)

test_credentials: admin@autoacquire.ai / Admin123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Real Google sign-in not automatable — validation-only per instructions.
seed_data_creation: None. Only read/login operations against seeded admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Emergent Google auth (session_id hash + /api/auth/google/session) has been fully replaced by real GIS: frontend renders the official Google button when REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is set, and backend verifies google ID tokens via google.oauth2.id_token.verify_oauth2_token with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID from backend/.env. A REAL Google popup CANNOT be completed in automation (Google blocks bots) — only verify iframe injection + endpoint validation (401 for invalid credential, 422 for missing field). Existing regression suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, test_gemini_public_chat.py, test_auth_google_regression.py.
